title: __**Happy Birthday Lyney and Lynette**__
description:
Happy birthday to the magical Fontaine twins, heirs of the House of the Hearth, Lyney and Lynette! We were quite thorough last year in exploring and celebrating the life of Fontaine's dynamic duo, so this year we will discuss more miscellaneous fun facts. At first, Lyney seems much more open, friendly, and easygoing compared to Lynette and Freminet, who are both shy and introverted. But he confirms in his voice lines that this too, is part of the shell persona he has created to masquerade his true, equally quiet self. None of the siblings had an easy upbringing. All three of them were orphaned at a very young age-taken advantage of by cruel predatory adults. Only to be rescued by none other than the Knave-Arlecchino. 

This forever bound their fates to her, and Lyney and Lynette would join the House of the Hearth in order to repay their debts to Arlecchino and to make it their new home. It was around this time Lyney took up interest in what he is now famous for: magic. Studying under Cesar, Lyney and Lynette-who already had much natural talent in performing magic tricks, would further hone their craft under the great magician. He became almost a father to them, for while they were simply studying magic in order to improve their effectiveness in their covert missions as Fatui operatives, they were genuinely fond of eachother. Just as the Traveler and Lyney are genuinely fond of eachother. In the English dub-Lyney is actually voiced by Cat Protano. Who would go on to voice Skirk. 

Their birthday, February 2nd, also happens to be Groundhog Day in North America, as spring is about to be heralded in and the new year really kicks off. It is also a date if much historical significance, such as the end of the Mexican-American War with the signing of the Treaty of Guadalupe-Hidalgo, Siege of Mantua during the Napoleonic Wars, the Battle of Stalingrad during WWII, and the completion of the military coup in Myanmar in 2021. February 2nd, 1653 is also the day New Amsterdam (now New York City) is incorporated. Making today New York's founding day.
